title: Wikidata plus Wikimedia Commons named-POI reference bank
summary: Public entity identities, coordinates, aliases, and Commons images can form a reusable target knowledge pack for named destination grounding.

mechanisms.name: Public POI multi-view reference bank
mechanisms.description: Bind a user-named public entity to multiple facade, entrance, architectural-context, and wayfinding views before online search; compare live observations against the bank without requiring readable OCR.
inputs: Wikidata QID, coordinates, aliases, Commons category and image metadata
outputs: Hash-frozen entity-specific reference views with provenance and license metadata
mechanisms.limitations: Commons categories contain portraits, events, interiors, and distant context; category membership is not current-frame target visibility truth and reference coverage must be source-audited before evaluation.
